summary: Create an app/site for a computer & laptop repair plus CCTV/networking services company named "Legend Techno Solutions".
architectural_notes: Branding decision: use the uploaded dragon logo image as the new official Legend Techno Solutions logo (replace existing logo site-wide and align related branding assets as needed).
Home page hero background should support a short looping video asset (optimize for performance and provide fallback for devices/browsers that can’t autoplay video).
known_issues: Build/deployment process failed during app creation; user requested retry.
Contact form submission is failing in production with error message: "failed send message try again" (backend/API not reachable or returning error).
Services section images are not displaying (service category pictures missing).
User requested to "fix the website" (general fix request; specific failing areas not specified).
Admin panel access shows "You do not have permission" / "Access Denied" for the user (likely not logged in with the owner Internet Identity used during site creation).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Short looping laptop/motherboard repair video clip (legend-techno-hero-bg-video.dim_1600x900.mp4)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for “Legend Techno Solutions” focused on computer repair, laptop repair, CCTV installation, and networking services, with clear navigation and calls-to-action.

Implement a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, components) suitable for a technical repair/services brand, and apply it consistently across all pages/sections (avoid default template look).

Add a Services section/page that clearly presents service categories: Computer Repair, Laptop Repair, CCTV Installation, and Networking, each with a short description and a simple “Request Service” CTA linking to the Contact form.

Add an About section/page describing Legend Techno Solutions and its service coverage, including a concise value proposition and a small list of differentiators (e.g., fast turnaround, genuine parts, on-site support) using neutral, non-claimy wording.

Create a Contact page/section with a form that captures: name, phone/email, service type (select), message/issue description, and preferred contact method; validate inputs on the client and show success/error states.
Add a simple Admin page in the frontend that displays stored contact inquiries in a table/list, with basic client-side filtering by service type and most-recent-first sorting.
Integrate required generated brand images as static assets (served from frontend/public/assets/generated) and use them in the header/hero and favicon/app icon where appropriate.
Replace the current Legend Techno Solutions logo image with a new logo design, and update all frontend references so the new logo is used wherever the old logo appears (site header and footer).
Replace the current favicon/app icon with a new version that matches the updated logo, and update the HTML metadata references accordingly.
Add the uploaded logo image as a static asset in the frontend and use it as the primary Legend Techno Solutions logo wherever the current logo is displayed (site header and footer).
Add the user-uploaded logo image to the frontend as a static asset and update all logo usages so the site header and footer display the new uploaded logo instead of the current generated logo asset.
Update the site’s displayed contact phone number to 7019071669 wherever a phone number is shown in the UI (including the Contact section’s Contact Information card).
Update the site’s displayed contact email address to "swaroop29@icloud.com" everywhere an email is shown in the UI (including the Contact section’s Contact Information card).

Fix the Contact form so submitting an inquiry successfully calls the backend `createInquiry` method in production and no longer shows the error toast/message “Failed to send message / try again” under normal conditions.

Improve Contact form failure handling so that when submission cannot be completed (e.g., backend unreachable), the UI displays a clear, user-facing error state in English with actionable next steps, and the form remains editable for retry.

Prevent premature submission before the backend actor is ready by gating the submit action on actor readiness and providing a lightweight loading/disabled state for the Send Message button until the actor is available.

Convert the marketing website content (Hero, Services, About, and Contact section copy such as headings/subheadings and business hours) to be data-driven by loading the content from the Motoko backend instead of hardcoded constants in React components.
Add an admin-restricted backend method to update the site content object so the website can be updated without redeploying, and add a minimal Admin UI to edit and save this site content.

Fix and verify the Contact form submission flow in production so that submitting an inquiry successfully calls the backend `createInquiry` method and does not show the user-facing error state/toast under normal successful conditions.

Add animated service-category pictures to the Services section by rendering a distinct image for each service card (Computer Repair, Laptop Repair, CCTV Installation, Networking Solutions) and applying a lightweight, non-distracting animation (e.g., slow float/tilt/pulse) that runs smoothly and does not impact layout.

Replace the Home page (Hero section) background image with a new image asset and update the Hero section to reference the new asset instead of the current `/assets/generated/legend-techno-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png`.

Change the overall site theme (colors/typography/component styling) to a clearly different, cohesive look across the marketing pages while keeping all content and functionality the same. Replace hardcoded amber color utility usage in key UI elements (header, hero CTAs, service cards, about highlights, contact highlights, footer) with the updated theme tokens/semantic colors so the theme is applied consistently.

Fix the Services section so each service card reliably displays its image in production by ensuring the referenced static assets exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and that the image `src` paths in `frontend/src/components/sections/ServicesSection.tsx` match the actual filenames exactly (including case and extension).

Add graceful frontend fallbacks for service card images so that if an image cannot be loaded, the UI displays a neutral placeholder state (e.g., a muted background with the service icon and a short label) instead of a broken image, without changing the layout height of the card.

Update the About section (`frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSection.tsx`) to display a background image behind the section content, with a readable overlay (e.g., gradient/tint) so headings, cards, and feature items remain clearly legible across light/dark themes and all screen sizes. Reuse the existing site background image pattern used by the Hero section (CSS `backgroundImage` + `backgroundSize: cover` + `backgroundPosition: center`) and ensure the background does not change the layout or spacing of the section content.

Perform a full production smoke-test of the marketing site (Home view) and Admin view and fix any runtime errors, broken navigation, or broken section scrolling so the website works reliably end-to-end.
Ensure the application build and deploy pipeline completes successfully for both frontend and backend, and fix any configuration/build issues that prevent successful deployment.

Update the site header and footer logo so that clicking/tapping the logo opens an enlarged view (modal/lightbox) of the same logo image (`/assets/generated/legend-techno-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`), and allow the user to close the enlarged view via a visible close control, clicking the backdrop, or pressing Escape.

Make the displayed public contact phone number clickable/tappable so that pressing it opens the device dialer using a `tel:` link wherever the phone number is shown in the UI (at minimum in the Contact section’s “Contact Information” card). Use the existing configured number from `frontend/src/config/contact.ts` and keep the visual style consistent with surrounding text (with clear hover/focus/keyboard accessibility).

Add an animated short laptop/motherboard repairing video as the Home page Hero background, rendered behind the existing Hero content with a readable overlay. The video must autoplay (muted), loop, and play inline on mobile, and it must gracefully fall back (e.g., to the existing hero background image) if the video cannot be loaded.

Switch the site to use a dark theme by default across the marketing pages (Home sections) and Admin view, ensuring text, borders, cards, and CTAs have sufficient contrast and the overall look is consistently dark.

Add a cookie consent/notice banner that appears on the site until the user accepts (and optionally declines). Persist the choice locally so the banner does not reappear on subsequent visits, and include clear English user-facing text.

Add a public website rating feature for Legend Techno Solutions so visitors can submit a rating (e.g., 1–5 stars) and an optional comment, and display recent ratings on the marketing site near the end of the Home page (after the Contact section).
Extend the Admin dashboard to allow viewing submitted website ratings in a simple table/list (most recent first) so the business can review feedback.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an app/site for Legend Techno Solutions (computer/laptop repair and CCTV/networking services).
Persist contact inquiries in the Motoko backend and expose APIs to create an inquiry and list inquiries (for basic admin viewing). Store timestamp and all submitted fields.
Update/change the Legend Techno Solutions logo (replace current logo asset and reflect it in header/branding/favicon as applicable).
Update site-wide contact phone number to 7019071669 (display wherever contact info appears).
Update the site's displayed contact email address to swaroop29@icloud.com wherever an email is shown in the UI (including Contact section/contact info).
Convert the marketing site into a more dynamic/data-driven website (content/features driven by backend data rather than purely static pages).
Add animated images/visuals in the Services section (e.g., animated service category pictures).
Change/replace the main image on the Home page (hero/home section).
Change the site theme (update overall visual styling/colors/typography/components).
Add/place a background image in the About section.

Update the Motoko backend default `SiteContent` values so that a fresh deploy (or empty state) shows Legend Techno Solutions-specific copy (hero/services/about/contact + business hours) instead of generic business placeholder text.
Make the site logo clickable so that when the user clicks it, it opens in an enlarged view (e.g., modal/lightbox) for better visibility.
Make the displayed contact phone number clickable/tappable so that pressing it opens the device dial pad (tel: link) across the site (e.g., header/footer/contact section).
Add an animated short video (laptop/motherboard repairing) as the Home page hero background.
Switch the overall site theme to a dark theme (dark mode styling across pages/sections).
Add a cookie consent/notice banner to the site.
Add a website rating feature/page/section for Legend Techno Solutions (users can leave a rating).
